workflow.name: Defender device timeline
workflow.description: From the menu of an asset of a case, "Pull Defender timeline" asks the analyst for the days to pull (and optionally the event types), then pulls the events of that device from Microsoft Defender Advanced Hunting (Microsoft Graph runHuntingQuery) and writes them to the case datastore as CSV, folder "Defender timelines", one file per 200 events. The tenant is the ENTRA_TENANT_ID key/value of the customer of the case, read with iris_customers_get, so one app registration serves every customer. Needs a multi-tenant Entra app with the ThreatHunting.Read.All application permission, consented in each customer tenant, and the keystore entries MDE_CLIENT_ID and MDE_CLIENT_SECRET (restrict them to login.microsoftonline.com). The asset name must be the device name in Defender. Defender keeps 30 days; a run stops after 150 pages (30,000 events) and says where. Cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with ' so spreadsheets do not run them.

config.code:
# The KQL of the next page: the events of the device in the window, oldest first, after the cursor
# (the last tick read, plus the events already read at that tick)
INITIATING = ['InitiatingProcessAccountName', 'InitiatingProcessFileName', 'InitiatingProcessId',
              'InitiatingProcessCommandLine']
COLUMNS = {
    'DeviceProcessEvents': ['ActionType', 'FileName', 'FolderPath', 'SHA256', 'ProcessId', 'ProcessCommandLine',
                            'AccountDomain', 'AccountName'] + INITIATING,
    'DeviceNetworkEvents': ['ActionType', 'RemoteIP', 'RemotePort', 'RemoteUrl', 'LocalIP', 'LocalPort',
                            'Protocol'] + INITIATING,
    'DeviceFileEvents': ['ActionType', 'FileName', 'FolderPath', 'SHA256'] + INITIATING,
    'DeviceRegistryEvents': ['ActionType', 'RegistryKey', 'RegistryValueName', 'RegistryValueData'] + INITIATING,
    'DeviceLogonEvents': ['ActionType', 'AccountDomain', 'AccountName', 'LogonType', 'RemoteIP', 'RemotePort',
                          'Protocol'] + INITIATING,
    'DeviceImageLoadEvents': ['ActionType', 'FileName', 'FolderPath', 'SHA256'] + INITIATING,
    'DeviceEvents': ['ActionType', 'FileName', 'FolderPath', 'SHA256', 'ProcessId', 'ProcessCommandLine',
                     'AccountDomain', 'AccountName', 'RemoteIP', 'RemotePort', 'RemoteUrl', 'LocalIP', 'LocalPort',
                     'RegistryKey', 'RegistryValueName', 'RegistryValueData', 'AdditionalFields'] + INITIATING,
}
# Every column is text, cut so that a page stays under the 1 MiB of the answer that is read
WIDTHS = {'ProcessCommandLine': 512, 'InitiatingProcessCommandLine': 512, 'AdditionalFields': 512,
          'FolderPath': 300, 'RegistryKey': 300, 'RemoteUrl': 300, 'RegistryValueData': 256}

target = inputs['target']
window = inputs['window']
last = inputs['last'] if is_dict(inputs['last']) else {}
cursor = str(last.get('cursor') or '0')
seen = last.get('seen') if is_list(last.get('seen')) else []
size = int(last.get('page_size') or inputs['page_size'] or 200)
if re_fullmatch('[0-9]{1,20}', cursor) is None:
    fail(f'Bad cursor {cursor[:40]}')
for key in seen:
    if not is_str(key) or re_fullmatch('[A-Za-z]{1,64}:-?[0-9]{1,20}', key) is None:
        fail(f'Bad event key {str(key)[:80]}')

parts = []
for table in window['tables']:
    columns = ', '.join([f'{c} = substring(tostring({c}), 0, {WIDTHS.get(c, 128)})' for c in COLUMNS[table]])
    parts.append(f'({table} | where Timestamp >= window_start and Timestamp < window_end and '
                 f'(DeviceName =~ host or DeviceName startswith host_dot) '
                 f'| project Timestamp, ReportId, DeviceName, Table = "{table}", {columns})')
if seen:
    after = f'| where Ticks > {cursor} or (Ticks == {cursor} and Key !in (dynamic([{", ".join([json_dumps(k) for k in seen])}])))'
else:
    after = f'| where Ticks >= {cursor}'
kql = '\n'.join([
    f'let host = "{target["host"]}";',
    'let host_dot = strcat(host, ".");',
    f'let window_start = datetime({window["start"]});',
    f'let window_end = datetime({window["end"]});',
    'union ' + ',\n    '.join(parts),
    '| extend Ticks = tolong(Timestamp), Key = strcat(Table, ":", tostring(ReportId))',
    after,
    '| order by Ticks asc, Key asc',
    f'| take {size}',
    '| extend Ticks = tostring(Ticks)',
])
result = {'kql': kql, 'cursor': cursor, 'seen': seen, 'page_size': size,
          'pass': int(last.get('pass') or 0) + 1, 'files': int(last.get('files') or 0),
          'total': int(last.get('total') or 0)}

# One page of the Advanced Hunting answer as CSV, and where the next page starts
MAX_SEEN = 2000  # events sharing one tick before giving up
COLUMNS = ['Timestamp', 'Table', 'DeviceName', 'ActionType', 'AccountDomain', 'AccountName', 'LogonType',
           'FileName', 'FolderPath', 'SHA256', 'ProcessId', 'ProcessCommandLine', 'InitiatingProcessAccountName',
           'InitiatingProcessFileName', 'InitiatingProcessId', 'InitiatingProcessCommandLine', 'RemoteIP',
           'RemotePort', 'RemoteUrl', 'LocalIP', 'LocalPort', 'Protocol', 'RegistryKey', 'RegistryValueName',
           'RegistryValueData', 'AdditionalFields', 'ReportId']


def cell(value):
    text = '' if value is None else str(value)
    # A spreadsheet runs a cell starting with one of these as a formula
    if text[:1] in ('=', '+', '-', '@', '\t', '\r'):
        text = "'" + text
    if re_search('[",\\r\\n]', text) is not None:
        text = '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return text


response = inputs['response'] if is_dict(inputs['response']) else {}
query = inputs['query']
target = inputs['target']
window = inputs['window']
max_passes = int(inputs['max_passes'] or 150)
size = query['page_size']
body = response.get('body')
results = []
shrink = False
if response.get('dry_run'):
    # Nothing was asked
    results = []
elif not is_dict(body) or not is_list(body.get('results')):
    # More than the 1 MiB read (cut, so not JSON): ask the same page again, smaller
    if size <= 10:
        fail(f'Defender did not answer JSON, even for {size} events: {str(body)[:300]}')
    shrink = True
else:
    results = body['results']

rows = len(results)
cursor = query['cursor']
seen = query['seen']
if rows:
    last_tick = str(results[-1].get('Ticks') or '')
    if re_fullmatch('[0-9]{1,20}', last_tick) is None:
        fail('The answer has no Ticks column: was the query changed?')
    at_last = [str(r.get('Key')) for r in results if str(r.get('Ticks')) == last_tick]
    seen = seen + at_last if last_tick == cursor else at_last
    cursor = last_tick

files = query['files'] + (1 if rows else 0)
done = not shrink and rows < size
truncated = not done and (query['pass'] >= max_passes or len(seen) > MAX_SEEN)
lines = [','.join(COLUMNS)] + [','.join([cell(r.get(c)) for c in COLUMNS]) for r in results]
result = {
    'rows': rows,
    'csv': '\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n',
    'filename': f'{target["host"]}_{window["label"]}_part-{str(files).zfill(3)}.csv',
    'first': results[0].get('Timestamp') if rows else None,
    'last': results[-1].get('Timestamp') if rows else None,
    'cursor': cursor,
    'seen': seen,
    'page_size': max(10, size // 2) if shrink else size,
    'pass': query['pass'],
    'files': files,
    'total': query['total'] + rows,
    'done': done,
    'truncated': truncated,
    'more': not done and not truncated,
}
